items.title: Fed watchdog finds renovation failures, but no grounds for criminal referral
items.description: The long-awaited report by the Fed's inspector general said it found no reasonable grounds to believe federal criminal law had been violated.

items.title: DOJ accuses Minnesota federal judges of misconduct for NY Times immigration interviews
items.description: The Department of Justice seeks the recusal of the judges who spoke to The New York Times from any cases involving the Department of Homeland Security.

items.title: Trump's latest global tariffs face trade court challenge
items.description: The Trump administration says the tariffs respond to countries failing to effectively ban the trade of goods produced using forced labor practices.

items.title: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick reports more than $250 million in income last year
items.description: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick unwound his ties to Cantor Fitzgerald as the billionaire financier joined the Trump administration.

items.title: Trump administration starts sending $500 Obamacare refund checks — who stands to benefit
items.description: The refunds come after millions of people lost premium subsidies for their health insurance, and right before the midterm elections.

items.title: Stellantis CEO reconfirms 2026 guidance, says turnaround plan continues as automaker's shares hit new low
items.description: Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa on Wednesday reconfirmed the company's 2026 guidance and its plans to be cash flow positive by 2027.

items.title: The market search for balance sheet 'cash cows' and 'quality' stocks is changing
items.description: With AI spending consuming the cash of the market's richest companies, balance sheet metrics led by free cash flow are getting more investing attention.

items.title: Treasury launches student loan support center as new data show 9.3 million borrowers in default
items.description: The Trump administration announced on Wednesday that it was launching a "Default Loans Support Center" for student loan borrowers who've fallen behind.

items.title: FTC is investigating OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI companies over product risks
items.description: The probe adds to the mounting scrutiny that OpenAI and Anthropic have been facing over their safety practices following the Hugging Face hack.

items.title: Nvidia is approaching a breakout level. Plus, what we want to see from Micron
items.description: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.

items.title: Trump's meeting with tech leaders leaves AI safety more unsettled than ever
items.description: Following Trump's lunch with artificial intelligence leaders at the White House, the industry remains largely unchanged on AI safety.

items.title: Senate expected to vote on stock trading ban, data center bill before election recess
items.description: The Senate will vote on bills that would ban members from trading stocks while in office, and to address data center-related utility costs, amid Democratic opposition.

items.title: People switching to Novo's Wegovy pill from obesity injections kept losing weight in real-world study
items.description: The data on Novo's Wegovy pill suggests that patients may not need to take weekly injections forever, but can instead opt for more convenient treatments.

items.title: 'Super intelligence is a national security issue,' Jay Clayton says; dodges AI 'czar' question
items.description: A media report this week said President Donald Trump stated that Clayton, the director of national intelligence, would make a good AI czar.

items.title: Fed’s preferred gauge showed core inflation at 3.0% in August, much lighter than expected
items.description: The personal consumption expenditures price index was projected to show an annual gain of 3.7% on headline and 3.3% for core, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

items.title: Private sector jobs rose by 90,000 in September, better than expected, ADP reports
items.description: Private job creation picked up in September after a brief slowdown.

items.title: Parents who want to help their kids in a tough job market should avoid this 1 move, says career expert
items.description: Some well-meaning career advice from parents is "totally useless" for new grads today, according to journalist Jodi Kantor.

items.title: Eli Lilly says closely watched combo obesity regimen boosts weight loss in mid-stage trial
items.description: Lilly said it plans to start Phase 3 trials on the combo regimen adding its amylin drug eloralintide to tirzepatide at the end of the year.

items.title: Kalshi, Polymarket trading volumes on some products raises questions amid massive growth
items.description: Unusual trading patterns on Kalshi and Polymarket are drawing scrutiny as experts debate whether reported volumes reflect organic market activity.

items.title: Robinhood unveils weekend hours, AI agents to allow users to trade nonstop
items.description: Robinhood is broadening its offerings in a bid for more active traders who may be seeking trading access beyond traditional U.S. stock market hours.
